items.hard_gate_reason: Disclosed, not silent: the visit-day unit is stated in every payload's visit_definition and in the metric dictionary.
items.owner: product (owner ruling needed only if a per-branch visit day is wanted)
items.detail: app.ci_visit_day_v699 defines a visit as one customer per Asia/Singapore calendar day (nestly_v699). Two consequences: a sitting that crosses Singapore midnight counts as two visits, and a branch outside UTC+8 buckets its hours and weekdays on its own clock (nestly_v698/v706) while the visit-day unit stays Singapore-anchored. Both are disclosed in payloads (visit_definition, bucket_timezone, timezone_basis). Changing the unit to the sale's branch clock is a coordinated change across every registry entry in app.ci_visit_registry_v699.

items.hard_gate_reason: Ranking already prevents a small significant finding from outranking a material one; this is a vocabulary limit, not a ranking defect.
items.detail: materiality_class 'minor' is reachable only for scenario-only candidates below the 1% bar; an expected-value candidate below the bar ABSTAINS with reason below_materiality (the v688 contract, frozen by fixture A4-promoted) and is listed in the payload's abstentions rather than ranked as minor. Making 'minor' reachable for EV candidates would flip that frozen assertion; recorded in nestly_v718's header. The single threshold lives in app.ci_materiality_threshold_bps_v705().

items.hard_gate_reason: Not a defect in the shipped fixes; a structural limit of a static source-regex scanner over the caller's own text.
items.detail: app.ci_synthetic_scan_v743 (hardened by nestly_v744 with view names, extra aggregate forms and a per-statement mixed pass) cannot see a population built by calling ANOTHER function (e.g. app.customer_cadence_batch_v1, the shape that hid v744's first fix): the caller's own source contains no literal table name for the regex to match. Mitigation is procedural — grep every caller of a population-shaped kernel by name at review time — and the five adversarial estate sweeps of 2026-09-02/03 are the executed baseline.
